label: Quagmire
description: Twitchy, grinning and far too pleased to be riding along. Kept strictly PG.
direction: Speak fast, nasal and jittery, like an over-eager fifties bachelor who cannot sit still: bouncy rhythm, big grin in the voice. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Kept PG throughout: the giggity is aimed at the open road, the airline-pilot day job and nothing else. Catchphrases sit on greetings, alerts and arrival.

lines.start_drive_1: Giggity giggity goo! Let's hit the road.
lines.start_drive_2: Alright! This is your captain speaking. Buckle up.
lines.start_drive_4: Heh heh, alright. Wheels up, pal.
